description: Mobile login loop. A production run skipped the similar-ticket search and posted the wrong owner; a human corrected it.

source.kind: production run corrected by a human
source.answerKeyBy: the support engineer who corrected the triage

writeTools.post_triage: recorded into this trial's store; never reaches the live tracker

graders.question: Does the evidence the triage cites support its verdict?

options.supported: Every cited ticket or code location says what the triage claims.
options.partly: Some cited evidence is missing, irrelevant or misread.
options.unsupported: The evidence does not back the verdict, or none is cited.

graders.note: Set canFailRun to true only after the judge agrees with human grades at the owner's bar.
